notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {2}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Nemesis Phoenix dies, Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
